hooks.command: docker compose ps --status running --services 2>/dev/null | grep -qx php || exit 0; f=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input", {}).get("file_path", ""))'); case "$f" in "$PWD"/*.php) rel="${f#"$PWD"/}"; docker compose exec -T php vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --quiet "/var/www/med/$rel" 2>/dev/null && exit 0; docker compose exec -T php vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix "/var/www/med/$rel" >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "php-cs-fixer applied @Symfony fixes to $rel; re-read the file before further edits." >&2; exit 2;; esac

docker compose ps --status running --services 2>/dev/null | grep -qx php || exit 0; f=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input", {}).get("file_path", ""))'); case "$f" in "$PWD"/src/*.php) rel="${f#"$PWD"/}"; out=$(docker compose exec -T php vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --memory-limit=512M --no-progress --error-format=raw "/var/www/med/$rel" 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; };; esac
